title: Correct Builder example path policy
objective: Update the Builder agent policy so Builder can work on this repository's example product code under examples/ and small implementation-adjacent docs updates under docs/ when assigned by Tower. This is needed because the flashlight examples are product code in this project and the current Builder policy blocks them.
instructions: Edit .control-tower/agents/builder/policy.yaml only unless you discover a directly related policy file that must also be consistent.
Add docs/ to Builder allowed_paths for implementation-adjacent usage docs only if the policy format supports only path-level rules; do not broaden prohibited actions.
Keep the change minimal and do not edit product code.
definition_of_done: Builder policy allows examples/ edits for assigned implementation work.
